release_notes:
Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.67 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 01:30 PM):
- Browser Web Client v1.8.2 now mirrors Desktop Item Master 1:1: Auto Code & Barcode Gen + Printable Label preview, Smart Auto-HSN matching, Brand/Supplier/HSN Quick-Add, Include/Exclude GST live 5-column Breakdown, Serial/IMEI Manager (# S/N List) saved to API, and Active/Inactive status filter.
- All modal popups across Browser Web Client v1.8.2 and Android v1.8.2 (Build 12) no longer close when tapping outside the modal backdrop (only via explicit Close/Cancel buttons).
- Official Bill Settlement & Credit Reminder Receipts across Desktop .exe, Web v1.8.2, and Android v1.8.2 (Build 12): full & partial collections immediately open the Receipt Print/Share dialog and support Receipt reprinting from Settlement History.
